short_description: Evolutionary ecology research for continuous environment-driven plant specialization, developmental genotype-to-phenotype programs, species catalogs, population truth and representation-safe future runtime integration.
purpose: Prove that vegetation diversity and plant form can emerge from environmental fields, resource trade-offs, inherited developmental programs, mutation, competition, dispersal and history without hardcoded biome placement or canonical TREE/BUSH/GRASS classes.
